additional_close_selection: 30 missing registered closes: 17 terminal-activity candidates plus all 13 additional contract symbols from the same ten official notices intersecting the full 829-symbol axis, regardless of whether held. This is not complete exchange PIT certification.
availability_limit: Official static pages are current renderings, not full publication-version snapshots. Original/amendment clocks preserved where found; source-chain unknowns remain explicit.

boundary_coverage.meaning: Reviewed explicit scheduled boundaries; original births, short gaps and all source revisions not exhaustive.

clock_contract.announcement_visibility: announced_at_ms <= O*1000; no future announcement changes an earlier decision
clock_contract.bar_ts: UTC integer seconds, closed-bar right boundary

consumer_contract: MUST apply lifecycle_hold_guard.py to observation/decision eligibility. Raw calendar readers alone do not certify held intervals. No cash run authorized by this artifact.
execution_restriction_limit: All90 scheduled close intervals entered from exact notice wording/time. 87 explicitly prohibit new positions/non-reduce-only; 3 say new orders and do not certify reduce-only permission. Research cash must use a placement-time-aware policy; the original decision-time-only adapter is not certified for announcements arriving between decision and placement.

knowledge_hold_intervals.policy: Explicitly reject or mark unknown at decision/observation within [start,end). Do not certify inactivity from later notice.
knowledge_hold_intervals.reason: Original scheduled OPEN16:15 was revised at16:21 to17:00. Current consumers cannot represent the original belief followed by delayed-open revision.

new_risk_restriction_scope: Explicit no-new-position interval reconstructed for REEFUSDT and LEVERUSDT only. Other registered closes do not certify reconstruction of their preceding entry restrictions. Generation and funding remain active until CLOSE.
